incident_text: The portfolio page shows an error for many users since about 14:00; the assistant's balance answers still work.

truth.description: A web-app release (new account switcher) sends portfolio requests without the required account_id, so portfolio-svc rejects them with 400 and the page errors.

logs.msg: rejected request from web-app/5.2.0: 400 missing required parameter 'account_id'

changes.note: portfolio page v5.2: new account switcher

trap: the errors are logged by the callee (portfolio-svc, which also deployed recently) but the cause is the caller's release
